response.description: A viability quality inhering in a population by virtue of the bearer's long term survival inability.
response.label: lethal (sensu genetics)

response.description: A viability quality inhering in a bearer or a population by virtue of the bearer's ability to survive or the long term survival ability of a given population.
response.label: viable

response.description: A viability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's condition before death.
response.label: alive

response.description: A viability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the cessation of the bearer's life.
response.label: dead

response.description: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's decomposition into component parts.
response.label: decayed

response.description: A reproductive quality inhering in the young of an animal by virtue of the bearer's disposition to survive and develop normally.
response.label: brood viability

response.description: A viability quality inhering in a bearer or a population by virtue of some of it's members' inability to survive to reproduce.
response.label: semi-lethal (sensu genetics)

response.description: A viability quality inhering in a population by virtue of some of it's members' ability to survive.
response.label: semi-viable

response.description: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to being capable of indefinite growth or division.
response.label: immortal
